answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 20440 Country: India Title: I need visa of a particular country,i need to go there for work to support my family, Can u please provide me a dua so that i can get visa without any difficulties in one go, how to recite and how many times and for how many days. Question: I need visa of a particular country,i need to go there for work to support my family, Can u please provide me a dua so that i can get visa without any difficulties in one go, how to recite and how many times and for how many days. Answer ID: 20440 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/391/D=1431) (1) After Isha salah recite ya Latif ( یا لطیف ) 1100 times with durood 11-11 times before and after and then supplicate. (2) Perform two rakah nafl salatul hajah making fresh wudhu and after salah supplicate Almighty Allah. (3) For this purpose do istikharah as well. After Isha salah before going to bed offer two rakah salah with the intention of istikahrah and reciting istikharah dua go to bed. Do it for two, three or seven days. In-sha-Allah, your work would be easy and your heart would feel ease. The dua of istikhara is written in Bahishti Zewer. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
